name: TIC 149902216
description: A red giant observed by TESS, 10.8 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,065 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.17 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,769 K at its surface.
